entities.summary: Albertas Šimėnas is a Lithuanian politician who served as Prime Minister of Lithuania for 3 days, from 10 to 13 January 1991. He disappeared during the January Events and was replaced by Gediminas Vagnorius.

entities.summary: Albertas Šimėnas is a Lithuanian politician who served as Prime Minister of Lithuania for 3 days, from 10 to 13 January 1991. He disappeared during the January Events and was replaced by Gediminas Vagnorius.
